description: This file defines the ContentStreamEnumerator class which implements an iterator for parsing and inspecting elements within a PDF content stream. It provides methods for navigating through whitespace-separated elements, handling different element types, and maintaining internal state for iteration purposes.

classes.name: ContentStreamEnumerator
classes.description: An iterator class for enumerating elements within a PDF content stream.

methods.name: ContentStreamEnumerator
methods.description: Constructor initializes the enumerator with a content stream and associated PDF document.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current element in the iteration.

methods.name: MoveNext
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element.

methods.name: MovePrevious
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous element.

methods.description: Moves forward by a specified number of elements.

methods.name: MoveNext(Func<string, bool> check, bool nextMatch)
methods.description: Moves forward, filtering elements based on a check function.

methods.name: MoveNext(Func<string, bool> check, int steps, bool countMatchesOnly)
methods.description: Moves forward with filtering and count options.

methods.name: MovePrevious(int steps)
methods.description: Moves backward by a specified number of elements.

methods.name: MovePrevious(Func<string, bool> check, bool previousMatch)
methods.description: Moves backward, filtering elements based on a check function.
